newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PERUGIA STRIKER NEGRI SET TO JOIN ESPANYOL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PERUGIA STRIKER NEGRI SET TO JOIN ESPANYOL.

text.p: Italian Serie A club Perugia said on Wednesday they were preparing to sell striker Marco Negri to Spain's Espanyol.

Perugia chairman Luciano Gaucci said the board of the Spanish first division side were due to meet later on Wednesday to examine a preliminary transfer contract. "If the preliminary contract is approved, Negri will be off to Spain," he said.
Perugia will net around $3.5 million for the transfer and Negri, 26, will be offered a three-year contract worth some $1 million a season, according to media reports.
